stories.title: Hungary’s labour market tightens again, but risks are building
stories.summaryEn: HUNGARY: Hungary’s labour market appears to have shaken off its summer weakness. But still-elevated wage pressures, worsening firing intentions and persistent geopolitical uncertainty keep us cautious about the outlook

stories.title: Asia week ahead: RBI rate hike, and data on China, Japan, Korea
stories.summaryEn: ASIA/PACIFIC: Markets will watch the Reserve Bank of India’s expected 25bp rate hike, while keeping a close eye on China’s PMIs, activity indicators from Japan and South Korea, Philippine inflation data, and Taiwan’s local elections

stories.title: Rates Spark: Rates resist bearish pressure as France faces rating risk
stories.summaryEn: Bearish dynamics remain contained in European rates despite the ECB’s tightening bias and firmer energy prices. French spreads tightened ahead of S&P’s review, but political uncertainty and budget risks could warrant a negative outlook – and keep investors cautious

stories.title: FX Daily: Green Friday
stories.summaryEn: US stock markets look set to rebound in a shortened session today, after sentiment improved over Thanksgiving. While that can give breathing room to high-beta FX, EUR/USD is far from guaranteed to follow the move higher as markets start to price some Fed tightening back in. Focus will be on some eurozone CPI numbers today

stories.title: The Commodities Feed: Copper and gold rebound while oil extends gains
stories.summaryEn: Copper and gold continued to recover on Friday as risk appetite improved, while oil extended its advance amid renewed concerns over Middle East supply disruptions. Zinc also moved higher after the planned suspension of production at a European smelter

stories.title: Hedge funds like gilts, but not the risks
stories.summaryEn: EUROPE: Hedge funds are increasingly absorbing gilt supply through leveraged trading strategies but passing interest-rate risk to other investors. The Bank of England is looking at policy measures to mitigate the associated risks. Should hedge funds exit such trades, gilts would likely underperform swaps as gilts move to more expensive balance sheets

stories.title: French economy sinks deeper into gloom
stories.summaryEn: EUROPE: France’s third-quarter GDP contraction was deeper than previously estimated, confirming the sharp deterioration in the economy. Domestic demand shows no sign of recovery and the labour market is weakening. We now expect growth of just 0.1% in 2026 and 0.4% in 2027. The only good news is that inflationary pressures are easing

stories.title: CEE & CCA week ahead: Rate decisions in Poland, Kazakhstan to accompany GDP and inflation data
stories.summaryEn: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: The National Bank of Poland is expected to keep rates unchanged, while Kazakhstan faces a close rate decision. GDP and inflation data releases will also make for a busy week across the region

stories.title: Monitoring Romania: A recovery is taking shape, but the margin for error remains narrow
stories.summaryEn: CENTRAL AND EASTERN EUROPE: Romania enters 2027 at an economic handover point. The RRF sprint is over, and the next phase of growth should increasingly rely on recovering real incomes, continued investments and the addition of new energy and industrial capacity. But the recovery will remain vulnerable to fiscal execution and global financial conditions
